    Claims handlers are unable to process reserve adjustments when the primary approver is unavailable. This lack of delegation causes claims to stall indefinitely in the approval queue.

    Brief hidden: a deterministic check failed. Open anyway

    ## Problem Claims handlers cannot process reserve adjustments when the primary approver is unavailable, because there is no backup approver or delegation mechanism. Reserve changes that exceed a handler's authority enter an approval waiting list and remain there until the specific approver returns, stalling claims indefinitely [i:655489deaf46b80c] [i:fe5045f877fd2a57]. This delay blocks downstream activity including payments and reporting [i:d25753b53cd1ed5f]. ## Who is affected - Callowfield Auto Assurance, where claims are held up because the approver is out and there is no backup, causing the approval waiting list to pile up [i:17d1c301c6216534]. - Wexmoor Motor, where claims are stuck because reserve changes need approval but no one is covering for the approver [i:4da72a0298cc1806]. - Holloway Reach Underwriting, where reserve adjustments above the team's limit sit until the approver comes back, with no backup and no delegation [i:62370a71c63f0356]. - Ravensgill Insurance, where a reserve adjustment beyond a handler's limit goes into an approval waiting list and nothing moves if the approver is out [i:655489deaf46b80c]. - Harrowfield Fleet Mutual, where a reserve exceeding authority with the approver out and no delegate piles up on the approval waiting list [i:981bdf2d38caaa15]. - Pendleford Motor Mutual, where reserve changes wait for an approver on leave with no delegate set up [i:a220bdb07381e46e]. - Saltmarsh Specialty, where reserve updates beyond handler limits are stuck waiting for sign-off with no backup approver, halting payments and reporting [i:d25753b53cd1ed5f]. - Sallowmere Motor, which asked to review the roles assigned to its claims handlers because some tasks are getting stuck in the queue [i:293889b99ef6cf16]. ## Evidence - Across 8 accounts, there are 18 mentions of this problem, arriving via 3 routes: 7 via support, 6 via sales and 5 via account management [i:17d1c301c6216534] [i:293889b99ef6cf16] [i:981bdf2d38caaa15]. How it works

  1. Collect. Every night Keelwater's feedback is collected from calls, tickets and sessions.
  2. Clean. What customers said is kept, with the line before it as context that is never quoted, and idle session time is cut.
  3. Judge relevance. A small fast model decides what is product signal and what is noise, and a person checks a weekly sample of 40 dropped items.
  4. Extract and check. A model pulls out the problem and the customer's exact words, and code checks the words really appear in the source.
  5. Group and rank. Similar problems are grouped, matched to the roadmap and ranked with a formula the PM can read.
  6. Brief and review. The top ones get a cited brief, three judges from another model family check it, and a PM accepts, merges, rejects, parks or sends it to another squad.

   "raw_text": "Hello Pellin, happy to help \u2014 we\u2019ll walk you through the document upload process and any roles or integrations you need configured.",

   "raw_text": "That\u2019s great \u2014 we\u2019ve got a lot of policyholder files to attach to claims, so we\u2019re hoping there\u2019s a way to handle multiple file upload efficiently.",

     "end": 74000,
     "start": 67200,
     "text": "Also, repair updates missing \u2014 we\u2019re on the phone daily with garages because there\u2019s no live status."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 80400,
     "start": 74000,
     "text": "That\u2019s a blocker we hear often. We\u2019re exploring API integrations to pull live repair statuses directly."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 87200,
     "start": 80400,
     "text": "And when reserves go over limit? The approval waiting list just sits there if the approver\u2019s out."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 94000,
     "start": 87200,
     "text": "And when reserves go over limit? The approval waiting list just sits there if the approver\u2019s out."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 99600,
     "start": 94000,
     "text": "We\u2019re building delegation rules so approvals can route to backups automatically. That\u2019ll unblock claims."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 104400,
     "start": 99600,
     "text": "Perfect \u2014 that\u2019s exactly what we need. Let\u2019s talk about reporting next."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 110000,
     "start": 104400,
     "text": "Absolutely. We can show you how custom dashboards track claims, payments, and supplier performance."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 117200,
     "start": 110000,
     "text": "Thanks \u2014 and can we schedule the next session for next Tuesday? I\u2019ve got an audit that day."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 124800,
     "start": 117200,
     "text": "Of course \u2014 I\u2019ll send a calendar invite for Tuesday at 10 AM. Let me know if that works."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 129200,
     "start": 124800,
     "text": "Just confirming \u2014 does enterprise include unlimited integrations with garage systems?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 135200,
     "start": 129200,
     "text": "Yes, all tiers include integrations, but enterprise gives you priority API support and custom fields."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 138800,
     "start": 135200,
     "text": "Great \u2014 that\u2019s a relief. Appreciate the clarity, Alwen."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 144400,
     "start": 138800,
     "text": "My pleasure, Havren. I\u2019ll follow up with the demo notes and schedule confirmation shortly."

 "transcript": [
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 9200,
     "start": 0,
     "text": "Hi Alwen, thanks for the demo last week \u2014 we\u2019re really keen to get started with your system for handling claims and documents."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 16800,
     "start": 9200,
     "text": "Glad to hear it, Elwenna. We\u2019ve got integrations ready for your policyholders and suppliers, and reporting is fully configurable."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 26000,
     "start": 16800,
     "text": "That\u2019s good to know \u2014 but I need to flag something about uploading files together. We handle hundreds daily and need bulk uploads."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 33600,
     "start": 26000,
     "text": "We\u2019re reviewing our licensing tiers to see if we can adjust for higher document volume without increasing per-claim costs."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 42000,
     "start": 33600,
     "text": "Understood. The team shipped that capability on 6 October \u2014 you can now upload files together in one batch without delays."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 50400,
     "start": 42000,
     "text": "That\u2019s helpful, but we\u2019ve had a few cases where the system choked on large batches \u2014 maybe a bug or limit?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 59600,
     "start": 50400,
     "text": "Let me escalate that to engineering \u2014 we\u2019ll check if there\u2019s a threshold or performance issue with upload files together under heavy load."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 71600,
     "start": 59600,
     "text": "We\u2019ve been trying to use the bulk upload function since the update, but it\u2019s still not handling upload files together reliably \u2014 we get timeouts on batches over 50 documents."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 79200,
     "start": 71600,
     "text": "A ticket has been created for your upload files together performance feedback. You\u2019ll receive an update within 48 hours."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 84000,
     "start": 79200,
     "text": "Thanks \u2014 we\u2019ll hold off on full rollout until we hear back."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 92000,
     "start": 84000,
     "text": "We\u2019ll prioritize this \u2014 your feedback helps us improve the roles and tasks workflows for high-volume users like Thistlecombe Mutual."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 99200,
     "start": 92000,
     "text": "Appreciate that. Also, any update on the reserve calculation logic? We need it aligned with our reporting standards."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 107200,
     "start": 99200,
     "text": "Yes \u2014 the reserves module now syncs with your reporting templates and auto-populates based on policyholder data and supplier invoices."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 110800,
     "start": 107200,
     "text": "Perfect. Let\u2019s schedule the next review for next Tuesday?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 119200,
     "start": 110800,
     "text": "I\u2019ll send over a calendar invite for Tuesday at 10 AM \u2014 we\u2019ll walk through letters, payments, and any outstanding tasks."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 121200,
     "start": 119200,
     "text": "Sounds good. Thanks again, Alwen."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 126800,
     "start": 121200,
     "text": "You\u2019re welcome, Elwenna \u2014 looking forward to helping Thistlecombe Mutual streamline your claims process."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 132400,
     "start": 126800,
     "text": "We\u2019re counting on it \u2014 especially for managing suppliers and policyholders across multiple regions."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 140000,
     "start": 132400,
     "text": "We\u2019ve got you covered \u2014 our integrations handle regional variance, and roles can be tailored to each team\u2019s workflow."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 146400,
     "start": 140000,
     "text": "Great \u2014 we\u2019ll be ready to go live once the upload files together issue is resolved."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 153600,
     "start": 146400,
     "text": "Understood \u2014 I\u2019ll personally follow up with engineering and keep you posted on the upload files together fix."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 158000,
     "start": 153600,
     "text": "Appreciate the attention to detail \u2014 that\u2019s why we chose Keelwater."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 165600,
     "start": 158000,
     "text": "Thank you, Elwenna \u2014 we\u2019re committed to making sure every feature, from reserves to letters, meets your team\u2019s needs."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 168800,
     "start": 165600,
     "text": "Looking forward to it. Let\u2019s touch base Tuesday."

   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {

     "text": "Will do \u2014 have a great weekend, Elwenna."

   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {

     "start": 172000,
     "text": "You too, Alwen \u2014 talk soon."

   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 183200,
     "start": 174400,
     "text": "Just a quick note \u2014 we\u2019re also working on a new task assignment feature to improve workflow efficiency for your claims team."

   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [

  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {

     "text": "We\u2019ll include it in the next release \u2014 you\u2019ll be able to assign tasks based on roles and set automated reminders."

   "topic": ""

   "sentences": [

   "raw_text": "No delegate at all \u2014 and it\u2019s causing delays on reserve updates that need sign-off before we can process payments.",

   },
   "end_time": 37.2,
   "index": 3,
   "raw_text": "I see \u2014 so when a reserve change exceeds the handler\u2019s authority, it lands in one approver\u2019s queue with no fallback, and claims stall until they return. That\u2019s a known bottleneck.",

   "text": "I see \u2014 so when a reserve change exceeds the handler\u2019s authority, it lands in one approver\u2019s queue with no fallback, and claims stall until they return. That\u2019s a known bottleneck."

  {

    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 45.6,
   "index": 4,
   "raw_text": "Exactly \u2014 it\u2019s creating a backlog on the approval waiting list, and policyholders are starting to ask why payments are delayed.",

   "speaker_name": "Gellin Glenmere",
   "start_time": 37.2,
   "text": "Exactly \u2014 it\u2019s creating a backlog on the approval waiting list, and policyholders are starting to ask why payments are delayed."

  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 60.0,
   "index": 5,
   "raw_text": "We\u2019re seeing claims held up because when a reserve change exceeds authority, it sits in one approver\u2019s queue with no delegate, and that creates a backlog on the approval waiting list \u2014 policyholders are noticing delays.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Gellin Glenmere",
   "start_time": 45.6,
   "text": "We\u2019re seeing claims held up because when a reserve change exceeds authority, it sits in one approver\u2019s queue with no delegate, and that creates a backlog on the approval waiting list \u2014 policyholders are noticing delays."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 67.2,
   "index": 6,
   "raw_text": "Understood. We\u2019ll look at adding delegation rules to prevent the reserve authorisation delay from halting claims during absences.",
   "speaker_id": "staff",
   "speaker_name": "Deryn Pell",
   "start_time": 60.0,
   "text": "Understood. We\u2019ll look at adding delegation rules to prevent the reserve authorisation delay from halting claims during absences."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 78.4,
   "index": 7,
   "raw_text": "The issue is that reserve updates beyond handler limits are stuck waiting for sign-off with no backup approver, causing a reserve authorisation delay that halts payments and reporting.",

   "speaker_name": "Gellin Glenmere",
   "start_time": 67.2,
   "text": "The issue is that reserve updates beyond handler limits are stuck waiting for sign-off with no backup approver, causing a reserve authorisation delay that halts payments and reporting."

 ]

 "transcript": [

   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 15200,
     "start": 0,
     "text": "Hi Alwen, we\u2019ve got a bit of a headache here at Sallowmere Motor \u2014 same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, and now we\u2019ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 26800,
     "start": 15200,
     "text": "Thanks for flagging that, Pellin. I\u2019ll log this as a system behavior issue \u2014 we\u2019re aware of the duplicate loss report problem and it\u2019s on our backlog to fix."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 46000,
     "start": 26800,
     "text": "We\u2019ve got a real issue where the same incident came in both by phone and web portal, and now we\u2019ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it \u2014 that\u2019s what we\u2019re calling a duplicate loss report, and it\u2019s messing up our reserves and supplier coordination."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 53200,
     "start": 46000,
     "text": "Appreciate that. It\u2019s causing real confusion for our adjusters when reserves and payments get split across two records."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 62400,
     "start": 53200,
     "text": "Understood. We\u2019re prioritizing a warning at intake so this doesn\u2019t happen again \u2014 you\u2019re not alone in seeing this duplicate loss report issue."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 70000,
     "start": 62400,
     "text": "Good to hear. For now, can we at least manually merge them without losing any documents or supplier notes?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 85600,
     "start": 70000,
     "text": "Yes, you can \u2014 just assign both claims to the same policyholder and use the tasks tab to consolidate notes. We\u2019ll also add a reporting flag to help track these duplicate loss report cases until the fix is live."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 90800,
     "start": 85600,
     "text": "Thanks, Alwen. That\u2019ll help us keep things clean until the system catches up."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 100800,
     "start": 90800,
     "text": "You\u2019re welcome, Pellin. We\u2019ll keep you posted as we roll out the fix \u2014 your feedback on the duplicate loss report issue is really valuable."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 106800,
     "start": 100800,
     "text": "No problem. Let me know if you need any logs or screenshots from our end."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 116400,
     "start": 106800,
     "text": "Will do \u2014 if you could send over the claim IDs and timestamps for the duplicate loss report, that\u2019d help us reproduce it faster."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [

   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 127200,
     "start": 119600,
     "text": "Perfect \u2014 thanks again, Pellin. We\u2019re treating this as high priority since it affects reserves, payments, and supplier coordination."

   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {

   "speakerId": "staff",

   "sentences": [

     "end": 46000,

     "text": "We\u2019ve got a real issue where the same incident came in both by phone and web portal, and now we\u2019ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it \u2014 that\u2019s what we\u2019re calling a duplicate loss report, and it\u2019s messing up our reserves and supplier coordination."

  },

   "sentences": [

     "end": 53200,

   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [

     "end": 62400,
     "start": 53200,
     "text": "Understood. We\u2019re prioritizing a warning at intake so this doesn\u2019t happen again \u2014 you\u2019re not alone in seeing this duplicate loss report issue."

   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""

     "start": 62400,

   "speakerId": "customer",

  },
  {
   "sentences": [

     "end": 85600,

   "speakerId": "staff",

   "speakerId": "customer",

  },

  {

   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 10000,

  },

   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 32000,

     "text": "I hear you \u2014 it\u2019s a real pain point for your team. Let\u2019s look at how we can streamline that workflow with Keelwater\u2019s reporting and tasks modules."

   "speakerId": "staff",

   "topic": ""

   "topic": ""
  },

    "body": "Hi Bryn, I\u2019m having trouble with the dashboard totals not matching the CSV we export for finance.",

   {

     "name": "Bryn Telford",
     "type": "admin"
    },
    "body": "Thanks for flagging this, Celdra. Let me check if this is related to your login or a system issue.",
    "created_at": 1793101986,
    "id": "392697ed4c9c-1",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {

     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Celdra Cairnwick",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "Can we schedule a call for next Tuesday? I\u2019ll be available after 2pm.",

    "type": "conversation_part"

   {

     "name": "Celdra Cairnwick",
     "type": "user"
    },

     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Avenna Harthwick",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "Hi Bryn, I\u2019m trying to figure out why the latest payment batch didn\u2019t reflect in our supplier ledger \u2014 any idea?",
    "created_at": 1788968760,
    "id": "cd6d9ced8d0a-0",

    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "internal",
     "name": "Bryn Telford",
     "type": "admin"
    },
    "body": "Let me check the integration logs for your account \u2014 sometimes delays happen when policyholders update their bank details.",
    "created_at": 1788968768,
    "id": "cd6d9ced8d0a-1",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Avenna Harthwick",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "Can you walk me through how to attach supporting documents to a claims file in the system?",
    "created_at": 1788968776,
    "id": "cd6d9ced8d0a-2",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Avenna Harthwick",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "That\u2019s helpful, thanks. Also, could you confirm if the reporting module pulls data from all active roles?",
    "created_at": 1788968782,
    "id": "cd6d9ced8d0a-3",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Avenna Harthwick",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "I need to schedule a recurring task for monthly reserves review \u2014 is that possible via the dashboard?",
    "created_at": 1788968789,
    "id": "cd6d9ced8d0a-4",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "internal",
     "name": "Bryn Telford",
     "type": "admin"
    },
    "body": "Yes, it does \u2014 as long as those roles are assigned to active users and have access permissions set correctly.",

   {

    },
    "body": "Your query has been resolved and a summary has been emailed to your account contact.",

    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {

     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Avenna Harthwick",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "Got it. One last thing \u2014 can we automate letters for overdue claims? I\u2019m swamped with manual drafting.",
    "created_at": 1788968810,
    "id": "cd6d9ced8d0a-7",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },

     "id": "internal",
     "name": "Bryn Telford",

    },
    "body": "Absolutely \u2014 you can set up templated letters under the tasks tab and assign them to trigger on specific reserve thresholds.",

 "transcript": [
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 9200,
     "start": 0,
     "text": "Hi Alwen, just checking in \u2014 we\u2019ve been running claims through your system for three months now and it\u2019s been smoother than expected."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 15200,
     "start": 9200,
     "text": "We\u2019re evaluating whether the per-claim fee structure aligns with our volume projections for next year."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 20800,
     "start": 15200,
     "text": "Your team\u2019s responsiveness during our onboarding was genuinely impressive and made a big difference."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 28000,
     "start": 20800,
     "text": "Thanks, Avenna \u2014 we\u2019re glad to hear that. Is there anything specific you\u2019d like to discuss or improve?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 36400,
     "start": 28000,
     "text": "Actually, yes \u2014 our policyholders keep asking why they don\u2019t get automatic updates when their claim moves to the next stage."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 45600,
     "start": 36400,
     "text": "We\u2019ve had multiple policyholders ask why they aren\u2019t getting automatic alerts when their claim status changes \u2014 customer milestone messaging would solve this."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 52800,
     "start": 45600,
     "text": "That\u2019s a common request. We\u2019re currently building out customer milestone messaging, which should be available early next year."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 58400,
     "start": 52800,
     "text": "Understood. For now, we\u2019re manually sending claim progress messages, but it\u2019s time-consuming and inconsistent."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 66000,
     "start": 58400,
     "text": "Right now we\u2019re manually drafting and sending claim progress messages to keep policyholders informed, but it\u2019s inefficient and error-prone."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 72800,
     "start": 66000,
     "text": "We\u2019re tracking that workaround internally and will prioritize it as we roll out the full feature set."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 78400,
     "start": 72800,
     "text": "Appreciate that. Also, can you confirm if the supplier integrations support our third-party adjusters?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 87200,
     "start": 78400,
     "text": "Yes, all major supplier integrations are live and tested with external adjusters \u2014 you can assign them tasks directly in the system."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 94800,
     "start": 87200,
     "text": "Perfect. One last thing \u2014 are we able to customize the letters sent to policyholders for specific claim types?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 102000,
     "start": 94800,
     "text": "Absolutely. The letters module allows full templating by claim category, with dynamic fields pulled from the policyholder\u2019s record."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 106400,
     "start": 102000,
     "text": "That\u2019s exactly what we need. Thanks again for your help, Alwen."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 113200,
     "start": 106400,
     "text": "You\u2019re welcome, Avenna. Let us know if you need any help setting up those custom letter templates."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 115600,
     "start": 113200,
     "text": "Will do. Have a good week."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 122000,
     "start": 115600,
     "text": "You too \u2014 and don\u2019t hesitate to reach out if anything comes up before next quarter."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 123200,
     "start": 122000,
     "text": "Noted. Thanks again."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },

   "sentences": [
    {

  {

   "end_time": 8.8,

   "raw_text": "Hi Carys, thanks for setting up the demo \u2014 I\u2019ve got a few things I\u2019d like to flag before we go live.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Avenna Harthwick",
   "start_time": 0.0,
   "text": "Hi Carys, thanks for setting up the demo \u2014 I\u2019ve got a few things I\u2019d like to flag before we go live."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": true,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 16.4,
   "index": 1,
   "raw_text": "Could we schedule a follow-up for next Thursday at 10 AM? I\u2019ll need to coordinate with the claims team.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Avenna Harthwick",
   "start_time": 8.8,
   "text": "Could we schedule a follow-up for next Thursday at 10 AM? I\u2019ll need to coordinate with the claims team."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": true,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 21.2,
   "index": 2,
   "raw_text": "Of course, Avenna \u2014 I\u2019m here to help. What\u2019s on your mind?",
   "speaker_id": "staff",
   "speaker_name": "Carys Fenwick",
   "start_time": 16.4,
   "text": "Of course, Avenna \u2014 I\u2019m here to help. What\u2019s on your mind?"
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 29.2,
   "index": 3,
   "raw_text": "First, we need to set up a custom claim-reference format \u2014 our internal systems rely on specific prefixes and sequences.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Avenna Harthwick",
   "start_time": 21.2,
   "text": "First, we need to set up a custom claim-reference format \u2014 our internal systems rely on specific prefixes and sequences."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 41.2,
   "index": 4,
   "raw_text": "We really need to set up a custom claim-reference format because our internal systems use specific naming conventions and we can\u2019t have mismatches when pulling reports or syncing with suppliers.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Avenna Harthwick",
   "start_time": 29.2,
   "text": "We really need to set up a custom claim-reference format because our internal systems use specific naming conventions and we can\u2019t have mismatches when pulling reports or syncing with suppliers."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 47.6,
   "index": 5,
   "raw_text": "Got it \u2014 we can configure that during onboarding. I\u2019ll note it for the tech team.",
   "speaker_id": "staff",
   "speaker_name": "Carys Fenwick",
   "start_time": 41.2,
   "text": "Got it \u2014 we can configure that during onboarding. I\u2019ll note it for the tech team."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 59.6,
   "index": 6,
   "raw_text": "Also, there\u2019s an issue where uploaded documents sometimes end up misfiled \u2014 garage estimates get tagged as correspondence, and handlers have to move them manually, which risks missing critical evidence.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Avenna Harthwick",
   "start_time": 47.6,
   "text": "Also, there\u2019s an issue where uploaded documents sometimes end up misfiled \u2014 garage estimates get tagged as correspondence, and handlers have to move them manually, which risks missing critical evidence."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 72.8,
   "index": 7,
   "raw_text": "Uploaded documents are sometimes misfiled \u2014 garage estimates get dumped into correspondence, forcing handlers to manually reassign them, and that\u2019s where evidence can slip through the cracks because of incorrect file type assignment.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Avenna Harthwick",
   "start_time": 59.6,
   "text": "Uploaded documents are sometimes misfiled \u2014 garage estimates get dumped into correspondence, forcing handlers to manually reassign them, and that\u2019s where evidence can slip through the cracks because of incorrect file type assignment."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 82.0,
   "index": 8,
   "raw_text": "That\u2019s a serious concern \u2014 I\u2019ll log this as a priority bug. We\u2019ll need to fix the auto-classification logic to avoid overlooking evidence.",
   "speaker_id": "staff",
   "speaker_name": "Carys Fenwick",
   "start_time": 72.8,
   "text": "That\u2019s a serious concern \u2014 I\u2019ll log this as a priority bug. We\u2019ll need to fix the auto-classification logic to avoid overlooking evidence."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": true,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 89.6,
   "index": 9,
   "raw_text": "Appreciate that. Let\u2019s lock in a time to review the fixes \u2014 next Thursday at 10 AM still work?",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Avenna Harthwick",
   "start_time": 82.0,
   "text": "Appreciate that. Let\u2019s lock in a time to review the fixes \u2014 next Thursday at 10 AM still work?"
